# Sloth Money

> Sloth Money takes the work out of managing money with automated transaction categorisation, budget suggestions, savings goal scenarios, and an Agent API.

## Main pages

- [Sloth Money](https://slothmoney.app/): Product overview and permanent free-beta access.
- [Developer guide](https://slothmoney.app/developers/): Agent API authentication, CLI setup, account and investment views, current and historical budget activity, transaction filtering by opaque account reference, receipt extraction and confirmed receipt items, planned-budget updates, assigned-budget movements, transaction sharing and split changes, transaction notification rules and transient contract renewal-date extraction, server-backed goal previews, server-backed scenario previews, account-funded goal forecasts, month-anchored scenario contributions, goal priority ordering, transaction categorization, endpoints, and safe write workflows.
- [Privacy policy](https://slothmoney.app/privacy/): How Sloth Money handles personal and financial data.
- [Home planner](https://slothmoney.app/home-planner/): Start a private, no-signup plan for a deposit, mortgage scenarios, and the costs people often miss when buying a home.

## Developer resources

- [Sloth Agent CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@slothmoney/agent-cli): Public command-line client for inspecting and managing accounts, investments, budgets, goals, forecast scenarios, and reviewed receipt evidence; reading personal, partner-shared, and combined household portfolio views; choosing whether an owned account shares its balance or linked holdings for planning; reading an opt-in latest complete pending snapshot and read-only partner settlement/payment context; previewing account-funded goals and month-anchored scenario changes with the canonical server planner; filtering transactions by opaque account reference; reading current and historical money-in, money-out, and net budget activity; updating planned amounts; moving assigned budget money; changing owned transaction sharing and splits; managing transaction notification rules and transient contract renewal-date extraction; updating goal priorities; and categorizing booked transactions through the Sloth Agent API.
- [Sloth Agent CLI source](https://github.com/RathBala/sloth-agent-cli): MIT-licensed source code and usage documentation.
